messages.author: Maren Achterberg
messages.text: Harrow's 29 June week is under another client's option until the 19th — releasing it is Delia's call with me, not something we ask the sales desk for. Nothing pre-approved.

messages.author: Rui Saldanha
messages.text: Wayfinder will re-issue flex fares for the recorded change fee; the two basic fares are gone — new tickets at the group fare. Niko never had a ticket, he was added to the required list on agenda rev 3.

messages.author: Liam Okafor
messages.text: Heads-up: the Northgate renewal workshop landed on 14-15 July and I cannot move it. The May free/busy export on the drive predates it.
